name: cpig-66-percell-selector
description: 66 Per-Cell Type Selector (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Blending)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue spherical lattice structure composed of a dense wireframe mesh, visible in all viewports as a circular or round form.
setup.whatItDoes: Picks a different source field per lattice cell. Wire either a Pattern (int list) or a Selector field. Use for multi-material lattices.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A light-blue mesh showing a lattice of cells, each selecting a different source field type. Distinguish from Map Field Tile by the per-cell type variation.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
